verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents its own workspace-wide search through the MCP 'Search Workspace' tool, which covers tasks, Lists, Folders, and Docs. Brain² also claims to check the workspace for answers, but that is AI Q&A rather than a search feature. Comments are not named as searchable, and nothing evidences the speed or accuracy of results. Missing for 10: documented search over comments, evidence of fast or accurate results, a first-party in-app search feature doc, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results

citations.quote: Search Workspace | Searches for items across the entire ClickUp Workspace, including tasks, Lists, Folders, and Docs.
Brain² checks your workspace, apps, and the web for answers.
Brain² sees your tasks, docs, and conversations.
